name: Guardian Battle Drums summon the captured tauren drum display (#6873, #8978)
contract: Battle Drums 803683 places three gameobjects 9000117. The client gameobject cache records that entry with display 1032401 (world/expansion06/doodads/tauren/7tr_tauren_drumsmall01, present in GameObjectDisplayInfo.dbc); the server row carried 7217, the stock orc voodoo drum the reports describe as the wrong model. Each summoned drum must carry display 1032401.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: the drums wear the captured tauren drum display, not 7217
